settings.question: How quickly does it dry?
settings.answer: The mist dries to the touch in about 60 seconds so you can dress straight away. Colour then develops over 4–6 hours.

settings.question: How do I reach my back?
settings.answer: The 360° continuous spray works at any angle, making hard-to-reach areas like your back easy to cover evenly.

settings.question: Will it transfer onto clothes?
settings.answer: Once dry, the guide colour is touch-dry. We recommend loose, dark clothing while the tan develops.

settings.question: Can I build a deeper tan?
settings.answer: Yes. Apply a second light layer once the first has dried for a deeper, still streak-free glow.
